# Pull request checklist

- [ ] Control references are valid and no Control ID was reused or silently renumbered.
- [ ] Automated validators pass.
- [ ] Adapter platform claims are backed by verification sources or marked `UNVERIFIED`.
- [ ] SPDX attribution is present where applicable.
- [ ] Documentation, mappings, generated files, and changelog are updated when required.
- [ ] No duplicate normative control was introduced.
- [ ] Versioning and compatibility rules are respected.
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes include impact, evidence, and rollback/recovery considerations.
- [ ] No secret, personal data, or unsafe test material is included in the contribution.
